passages.title: Ukážka 2 – Plastic in the sea
passages.body: Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic end up in the oceans. Sea animals often mistake it for food, and many of them get sick. Scientists say that most plastic comes from the land, not from ships. Some towns now ban plastic bags, and volunteers clean beaches at weekends. Experts agree that the best solution is to use less plastic in the first place.

passages.title: Ukážka 7 – Electric cars
passages.body: Electric cars are becoming more popular every year. They produce no exhaust fumes, which makes the air in cities cleaner. Nevertheless, many drivers hesitate to buy one because of the high price and the lack of charging stations. Governments in several countries offer financial support to encourage people to switch. Experts predict that within twenty years most new cars will be electric.

questions.prompt: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
questions.explanation: Vidíme znak, že sa niečo stane: going to.

questions.prompt: You ___ wear a seat belt. It is the law.
questions.explanation: Must vyjadruje povinnosť.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: Reálna podmienka: if + prítomný čas, will.

questions.prompt: If I ___ rich, I would buy a boat.
questions.explanation: Nereálna podmienka: if I were.

questions.prompt: Dopíš modálne sloveso: ___ I open the window? (Môžem otvoriť okno?)
questions.explanation: Žiadosť o dovolenie: can, may alebo could.

questions.prompt: You ___ park here. It is forbidden.
questions.explanation: Mustn’t = zákaz.

questions.prompt: He denied ___ the window.
questions.explanation: Po slovese deny nasleduje tvar -ing.

questions.prompt: I ___ this song. It is great!
questions.explanation: Slovesá citov (love, like, hate) sa zvyčajne nepoužívajú v priebehovom čase.

questions.prompt: When I called him, he ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Dej, ktorý prebiehal v danom okamihu v minulosti: past continuous.

questions.prompt: I ___ him since Monday.
questions.explanation: Since + obdobie do dnes: present perfect (haven’t seen).

questions.prompt: Čo znamená „enough“?
questions.explanation: Enough = dosť, dostatočne.

questions.prompt: She is very ___. She never tells lies.
questions.explanation: Honest = úprimný, čestný.

questions.prompt: She lives ___ 25 Green Street.
questions.explanation: Pri presnej adrese s číslom: at.

questions.prompt: We went ___ holiday last year.
questions.explanation: On holiday = na dovolenke.

questions.prompt: If she ___ harder, she would pass the exam.
questions.explanation: Nereálna podmienka: if + minulý čas, would.

questions.prompt: I ___ to work yesterday because I was ill.
questions.explanation: Could = minulá forma can.

questions.prompt: According to the text, where does most plastic come from?
questions.explanation: Text hovorí o súši (the land).

questions.prompt: What do experts recommend?
questions.explanation: Najlepšie riešenie je používať menej plastu.

questions.prompt: What do sea animals often mistake plastic for?
questions.explanation: Zvieratá si plast často pomýlia s potravou.

questions.prompt: What do volunteers do at weekends?
questions.explanation: Dobrovoľníci cez víkendy čistia pláže.

questions.prompt: I ___ here since 8 o’clock.
questions.explanation: Since + čas začiatku, dej trvá do dnes: present perfect continuous (have been waiting).

questions.prompt: I look forward ___ you.
questions.explanation: Look forward to + sloveso s -ing (to je tu predložka): I look forward to seeing you.

questions.prompt: He made a big ___ by saying that.
questions.explanation: Správne spojenie je make a mistake (urobiť chybu).

questions.prompt: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
questions.explanation: Rada v nereálnej podmienke: If I were you, I would… (pri I sa používa were).

questions.prompt: She ___ for the company for ten years now.
questions.explanation: For + doba trvania, dej trvá do dnes: present perfect continuous (has been working).

questions.prompt: I ___ my keys when I got home, so I could not get in.
questions.explanation: Dej, ktorý prebehol skôr ako iný dej v minulosti: past perfect (had + 3. tvar).

questions.prompt: He promised that he ___ me the next day.
questions.explanation: V nepriamej reči sa will mení na would.

questions.prompt: Which word means “to make something better”?
questions.explanation: Improve = zlepšiť. Decrease = znížiť, damage = poškodiť.

questions.prompt: The film was so ___ that I fell asleep.
questions.explanation: Prídavné meno na -ing popisuje vec (boring film), na -ed pocit človeka (I was bored).

questions.prompt: She succeeded ___ passing the exam.
questions.explanation: Succeed in + sloveso s -ing.

questions.prompt: If we ___ earlier, we would not have missed the bus.
questions.explanation: Nereálna podmienka v minulosti: if + past perfect, would have + 3. tvar.

questions.prompt: Why do some drivers hesitate to buy an electric car?
options: Because of the price and few charging stations.
questions.explanation: V texte: „high price and the lack of charging stations“.

questions.prompt: What do governments do?
options: They ban all petrol cars now.
questions.explanation: V texte: „offer financial support to encourage people to switch“.

questions.prompt: What do experts predict?
options: Most new cars will be electric.
questions.explanation: V texte: „within twenty years most new cars will be electric“.
